housing: New Forest District wraps around the New Forest National Park, with coastal towns such as Lymington and New Milton, the Waterside towns of Totton, Hythe and Fawley by Southampton Water, and the Avon valley towns of Ringwood and Fordingbridge. Most households own their homes, and about one in seven rent privately, often in Victorian cottages, post-war estate houses and flats. Homes in the national park include older forest cottages, some thatched and some off mains gas.
checkinTips: Coastal homes in Lymington, Milford on Sea and Barton: photograph salt-pitted metal, window seals and any damp on seaward walls.
Forest cottages and thatched homes: record the thatch where visible, beams, wood burners and flues, and damp in solid walls.
Rural homes off mains gas: photograph the oil tank, its gauge level and the boiler service label.
Homes in the Avon valley near Ringwood and Fordingbridge: note any signs of past flooding on floors and lower walls.
Homes with forest grazing outside: record gates, cattle grids, fences and gardens, as ponies and cattle roam the open forest.
tenantHelp: Tenants with disrepair or safety concerns can contact New Forest District Council's Private Sector Housing Team, which can inspect homes and take enforcement action.
